items.evidence: Log lines 2-193 show 18 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 PCR wells A1-H12 with one tip.
Log shows 1 uL from each colony_plate well to the matching pcr_plate well (e.g. 196-197), then 1 uL from each primer_plate well to the matching well (1156-1537), using P20.
A new tip is picked up and dropped for every colony and every primer transfer (96 each); a single tip is used for master mix into empty wells, which is allowed.
protocol.comment records sealing and the full program: 98 C 30 s; 30 cycles of 98 C 10 s, 60 C 30 s, 72 C 30 s; 72 C 2 min; hold 4 C.
Steps follow the task order including the 3x mix after template; the comments are accurate, and the extra blow_outs and the 10 uL mix volume are benign, with no invented steps.

judge.summary: The protocol reproduces the required transfers: 18 uL master mix into 96 wells, then 1 uL colony template and 1 uL primer per well with fresh tips. It records the sealing and thermocycling program accurately. All five items pass.
